1. Perform and lead daily hatchery operational activities according to SOPs.

2. Carry out breeding support, larval rearing, nursery, and water quality monitoring tasks.

3. Monitor seed health, survival, and environmental conditions.

4. Support supervisors in maintaining biosecurity and safety standards.

5. Record operational and production data accurately.

Qualifications :

1. Minimum education of Vocational High School (SMK) or Senior High School (SMA).

2. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hatchery operations or water treatment.

3. Proficient in water quality monitoring and seed health management in compliance with SOPs.

4. Capable of implementing biosecurity standards and occupational health and safety (OHS) procedures.

5. Willing to be stationed in Banyuwangi.

1. Melakukan dan memimpin kegiatan operasional harian hatchery sesuai dengan SOP.

2. Menjalankan tugas pendukung pemuliaan, pemeliharaan larva (larval rearing), nursery, dan pemantauan kualitas air.

3. Memantau kesehatan benih, tingkat kelangsungan hidup (survival), dan kondisi lingkungan.

4. Mendukung supervisor dalam menjaga standar biosekuriti dan keselamatan kerja.

5. Mencatat data operasional dan produksi secara akurat.

Kualifikasi:

1. Pendidikan minimal SMK atau SMA.

2. Memiliki pengalaman minimal 1–2 tahun di bidang operasional hatchery atau pengolahan air.

3. Menguasai pemantauan kualitas air dan pengelolaan kesehatan benih sesuai dengan SOP.

4. Mampu menerapkan standar biosekuriti serta prosedur keselamatan dan kesehatan kerja (K3).

5. Bersedia ditempatkan di Banyuwangi.
